source_snapshot.procedure: Enter BIOS, edit ECC Leaky Bucket Threshold, save, and reset.
source_snapshot.criteria: Register behavior should match expectation; the second DIMM (DIMM_B) should still trigger system and BMC SEL logs.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: An operator performs the BIOS leaky-bucket setup and error injection; the agent only collects system and BMC SEL logs.

original_test_intent.purpose: Exercise the platform-approved memory RAS error path for the second DIMM position across every intended memory channel and verify the configured leaky-bucket/register response plus correlated host and BMC SEL reporting.
original_test_intent.target: The exact SUT memory topology, the owner-defined second-DIMM/DIMM_B position in each intended channel, its ECC/RAS registers, host error reporting, and BMC SEL.
original_test_intent.scope: Per-channel bounded error stimulation after an ECC Leaky Bucket Threshold change, followed by event correlation and configuration restoration; this is not a generic DIMM stress test.
original_test_intent.operation: A qualified operator applies the vendor-approved BIOS/RAS configuration and injection stimulus for each mapped target while the agent performs baseline, timestamped evidence collection, correlation, and recovery verification.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The source says all channels but does not define channel count, event count per target, injection order, or repetition; source timing is 20 attended and 20 machine minutes.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Each approved target produces the specified register transition and correctly identified host/BMC event without an uncontrolled error storm, mislocalization, no-boot condition, or unrecovered setting.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Topology-to-slot/channel map, exact threshold/default and register expectations, vendor injection SOP/tool, per-target stimulus timeline, host/UEFI/BMC SEL records, event/location correlation, bounded event count, and restored/rebooted healthy state.
ambiguities: `2nd DIMM`, `DIMM_B`, and `all channel` are not mapped to physical slot labels or memory-controller/channel identifiers.
The procedure changes a threshold but omits the actual error-injection action, error type, count, and target mechanism.
Expected register behavior and expected system/BMC event fields are undefined.
source_conflicts: The Item and Criteria require an error to be triggered, but the Procedure contains no error-injection step beyond changing a BIOS threshold.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly prohibits autonomous BIOS/register/injection actions, requires a qualified operator, limits events, maps DIMMs/channels, preserves logs, and restores settings. Its MANUAL ONLY classification overlooks that a substantial, machine-verifiable host/BMC collection and per-event correlation phase can be automated after the manual fixture/setup and stimulus.

applicable_history.decision: Manual physical or BIOS steps do not make automated evidence collection impossible; V3 explicitly classifies hybrid manual setup plus automated verification as REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: This is a hybrid test: the approved BIOS configuration and error stimulus require a qualified operator, while baseline capture, host/BMC log collection, per-target correlation, and restoration verification can be automated. Execution remains prohibited until the omitted injection SOP, topology map, thresholds, evidence fields, and recovery sequence are supplied.

available_now: The broad memory-RAS purpose, required BIOS threshold area, all-channel intent, host/BMC evidence sinks, and need for a reset are explicit.
Read-only topology, current settings when safely exposed, host RAS logs, BMC SEL, firmware identity, and recovery access can be inventoried before injection approval.
missing_inputs: Exact platform DIMM-slot/channel map defining `2nd DIMM` and `DIMM_B` for every target
Vendor-approved injection tool/SOP, injectable error type and address/target method, bounded count per channel, injection order, and expected register transition
Original/default and test ECC Leaky Bucket Threshold values, required reboot semantics, expected host/BMC event IDs/location fields, stop thresholds, and cleanup/restore procedure
Qualified operator, isolated SUT, maintenance approval, console/OOB access, configuration backup, and data-integrity/recovery plan
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The platform memory/RAS and BIOS owners supply mapping, threshold/register semantics, injection SOP, expected events, and restoration; the lab owner provides the qualified operator, isolated window, and recovery authorization.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Record CPU/memory-controller/channel/DIMM slot topology, FRU/serial identities, BIOS/BMC/firmware versions, active workload, current host RAS logs, and BMC SEL without clearing evidence
Verify console/OOB reachability and prepare timestamp synchronization and per-event log correlation without writing BIOS or RAS state
prohibited_until_closed: Do not edit BIOS settings, reset, write RAS registers, inject errors, guess DIMM_B mapping, or reuse a vendor command from another platform
Do not clear SEL/OS logs, run on a production workload, inject unbounded events, or claim validation from a threshold change without actual approved stimulus and correlated evidence
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Owners sign off a per-target execution matrix containing physical slot/channel identity, exact setup and stimulus, event count, expected register/log fields, abort criteria, and restore/recovery checks; the operator and automated collector dry-run evidence timing without injection.

revision_candidate.test_name: Second-DIMM Memory RAS Injection Across Approved Channels
revision_candidate.purpose: For each owner-mapped second-DIMM target, perform a bounded approved ECC/RAS injection and verify the expected leaky-bucket/register behavior and correlated host and BMC SEL reporting.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact server board, CPU/memory-controller topology, BIOS/BMC/firmware build, supported DIMM population, vendor RAS tool/path, isolated maintenance environment, and OOB recovery.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Only the physical slots and channels explicitly mapped by the platform owner to the source's `2nd DIMM`/`DIMM_B` scope; do not infer labels across server architectures.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Per-channel slot map, original/test threshold values, register expectation, vendor injection SOP/tool and error type, bounded count/order, expected host/BMC records, maintenance approval, qualified operator, abort criteria, configuration backup, and restoration/recovery plan.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: The operator enters BIOS, records and applies the approved ECC Leaky Bucket Threshold, saves and resets as specified, then performs the documented bounded injection for one mapped target at a time. The agent captures synchronized pre/post register/status, host RAS/UEFI logs, and BMC SEL, correlates each stimulus, and verifies restoration after the matrix completes.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Dedicated no-workload SUT, verified topology and firmware, approved SOP and values, preserved baselines, synchronized clocks, working console/BMC/OOB, tested stop/recovery route, and explicit change/injection/reset approval.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Signed target matrix; before/test/restored threshold and register state; per-target injection command or operator record and timestamp; host and BMC SEL event identifiers, severity, address/location and count; unexpected-event check; boot/data-integrity health; and restored configuration.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Vendor/platform memory-RAS specification for the exact board/CPU/BIOS plus the owner-approved target/event matrix. The source text alone does not define register or event acceptance values.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Only the qualified operator performs BIOS changes and injection. Limit stimuli exactly as approved; never run on production data, clear logs, guess topology/registers, disable ECC protection, or continue after an uncontrolled or mislocalized event.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Explicit approval is required for BIOS changes, reset, each injection matrix, error limits, and recovery. The operator must confirm each target before stimulation.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: BIOS interaction, target verification, and vendor-approved stimulation are manual. The agent may automate read-only topology/log capture, correlation, completeness checks, and restoration verification.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop injection, preserve all evidence, restore the approved threshold/defaults through the vendor procedure, reset or power-recover only as authorized, verify normal boot and memory health, and quarantine the SUT on data corruption, no-boot, or persistent RAS faults.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Missing/ambiguous target map or SOP, unapproved setting/reset, active workload, event storm, wrong-DIMM/channel report, uncorrectable or unexpected error, data corruption, no-boot, thermal/power issue, loss of management, incomplete evidence, or inability to restore configuration.

identified_defects: The source procedure never specifies the error-injection stimulus required by the Item and Criteria.
The all-channel second-DIMM target is not mapped to actual slot/channel identifiers.
Register behavior, event type/count, and host/BMC acceptance fields are undefined.
V2 classifies the complete case as MANUAL ONLY even though evidence collection and correlation form a meaningful automated phase.
reason_for_change: Represent the actual hybrid execution boundary and prevent an agent from mistaking a BIOS threshold edit for the omitted all-channel DIMM error injection.

new_technical_evidence.title: No public platform-specific evidence applied
new_technical_evidence.applicability: The source does not identify CPU vendor, board, BIOS, register, or injection tool
new_technical_evidence.supports: No universal vendor command or threshold can be safely supplied from the available case data.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: All injection mechanics, topology labels, register behavior, and expected events require the exact vendor/platform specification.

removed_ambiguities: Separates BIOS threshold configuration from the actual missing injection stimulus.
Requires a concrete physical/channel mapping before interpreting DIMM_B.
Defines which work is operator-only and which evidence work is automatable.
resolved_blockers: Manual setup and injection do not make the whole case MANUAL ONLY; automated read-only collection and correlation are retained as a valid phase.
remaining_blockers: No state-changing execution may begin until the platform-specific injection SOP, map, expected behavior, limits, approval, and recovery are complete.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 corrects the capability classification to the documented hybrid category, identifies the missing injection step as a source conflict, and creates a per-target handoff that cannot confuse a threshold change with completed error injection. It does not relax V2's operator, isolation, bounded-event, or recovery gates.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The source says all-channel second-DIMM/DIMM_B error injection but lists only BIOS leaky-bucket threshold editing and reset.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 correctly protects the injection but calls the whole case MANUAL ONLY; V3 preserves manual stimulation and automates the evidence phase.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: No BIOS change or injection until a mapped, bounded vendor SOP exists; preserve host/BMC evidence and restore the exact original configuration.
